title: TraceableAI: AI Literature Review Assistant
short_desc: An open-source tool from Aarhus University that helps researchers work through large amounts of academic literature with AI — while showing exactly how every result was reached, so nothing is made up.
blueprint_desc: AI tools sometimes invent sources that don't exist, which makes them risky for research. This tool keeps a step-by-step record of everything the AI does, and every result links back to its original source so a researcher can check it. It follows PRISMA, the standard method for systematic literature reviews, and produces a ready-to-read paper preview with charts. It is headed for the OSSYM 2026 conference in Berlin.
tech_notes: Engineered a decoupled .NET 10 solution utilizing Mistral Large to parse and synthesize academic texts. To combat fabricated citations, the engine uses an isolated data capsule pattern that outputs a step-by-step process trace on every execution. It generates immediate, dual-column academic paper previews embedded with live empirical distribution graphs, mapping data points directly back to true source facts.
